newsitem.title: CHINA: China to boost development of coal gas.
newsitem.headline: China to boost development of coal gas.

text.p: China is to offer preferential treatment to boost exploitation of coal gas, or coalbed methane, said a senior official of the Ministry of Coal Industry.

To accelerate development of the new energy, the government will not collect a compensation fee for development of coal gas for a certain period of time, the Xinhua news agency quoted an official as telling a national conference.
The industry will also give priority to extending loans to key development projects, he said.
China has huge deposits of coal gas resources. In northern, northeastern and southern regions, exploitable coal gas resources amount to 3.5 billion cubic metres.

With state investment and foreign loans, China has set up more than 50 coal-gas development projects, building gas-holders with a total volume of 650,000 cubic metres and transport pipelines with a total length of 620,000 metres.
China currently uses more than 400 million cubic metres of coal gas a year, the official said.
